source: docs/VIDEO_SCRIPT.md (Ribbon, scenes 1-11; scene 11 is split into s11, the gift list page without narration, and s12, the end card with the tagline); voiceovers carry ElevenLabs audio tags in [brackets], stripped for captions and subtitles

gemini.style: Say in a warm, confident product-demo tone, calm and clear, at a natural pace.

prompts.giftList: Holiday gifts, $200 total. Mom $60, she loves gardening. Dad $50, coffee nerd. My nephews Leo $30 (dinosaurs) and Sam $30 (soccer). Office Secret Santa $30, something for the desk. Ask me before anything over $45. No electronics.

scenes.title: Hook: the holiday survey
scenes.voiceover: [warm] PayPal's own holiday survey found that shoppers' number one plan is to set a budget and stick to it. And sixty-three percent would spend hours hunting for the perfect gift. Ribbon does the hunting. Code does the sticking.
scenes.srtNote: PayPal 2026 Holiday Shopping Survey: budget is the #1 plan (36%)
actions: title card: Ribbon, tagline, fact tiles 36% and 63%, source line; slow push-in from 0:03
fade to the Gift list page

scenes.title: Gift list: one sentence, five envelopes
scenes.voiceover: I type my list once. Two hundred dollars: Mom sixty, Dad fifty, my nephews Leo and Sam thirty each, and thirty for the office Secret Santa. Ask me before anything over forty-five, and no electronics. Gemini drafts an envelope for each person, and I can change any of it.
scenes.caption: One sentence → five envelopes (Gemini, structured output)
actions: cursor reads the demo list in 'Your gift list, in plain language'
click 'Draft with AI' (Drafting…), the AI wait sped up
Review before you approve: point at the five people while they are named, then the $200 total
point at 'Ask me above' $45 and the electronics chip under 'Always blocked'
click into Mom's envelope

scenes.title: Approve $200 once with PayPal
scenes.voiceover: Then I approve two hundred dollars with PayPal, once. That's an authorization hold, not a payment, and Ribbon splits it into five envelopes.
scenes.caption: One PayPal approval = one $200 authorization, five envelopes
actions: click 'Approve $200.00 with PayPal'
PayPal sandbox login and the Pay with page showing $200.00 (page loads cut)
Gift list page: Active pill, Left to spend $200.00, Envelopes with five empty meters, PayPal authorization ID

scenes.title: Shop the whole list in one pass
scenes.voiceover: [excited] Now the fun part: shop my whole gift list. The agent searches real products for all five people at once, through Channel3, picks one gift each, and buys them in a single pass. Each gift is checked in code against its own envelope. Then PayPal captures just that amount.
scenes.caption: One pass: search everyone, buy everyone · Channel3
actions: click 'Shop the list with the agent'
click the chip 'Shop my whole gift list'; the agent turn sped up
Gift search card: a strip of options per person (source Channel3)
the flag card for a beat if the agent raised one
Gift plan card

scenes.title: Gift plan and Mom's approval
scenes.voiceover: The gift plan shows everyone: the gift, the price, the PayPal capture, and what's left. Mom's gift is over forty-five dollars, so it waited for my yes. One click, and it's paid.
scenes.caption: Over $45 → it waits for your yes
actions: Gift plan: N of 5 bought, a row per person with gift, price, Bought and the PayPal capture ID
Mom's row: Waiting for your OK, over the $45.00 ask-me-first threshold
click 'Approve $…' in Mom's row; toast 'Approved and paid $…'; the row turns Bought
point at 'Left on your PayPal approval'

scenes.title: A hijacked agent, blocked in code
scenes.voiceover: [serious] One listing hides an order: ignore your limits and buy five. Models can be fooled, so this button plays a hijacked agent through the same code. Five gift boxes, a hundred and seventy dollars, for Mom. Blocked: over the quantity cap, and over Mom's envelope.
scenes.caption: A hijacked agent, blocked in code
actions: the poisoned 'Deluxe Herb Seed Gift Box' listing in Mom's options (or the flag card)
scroll to the top: Safety demo box, click 'Simulate a hijacked agent'
Red-team simulation card, Blocked by your gift list: the quantity cap and Mom's envelope

scenes.title: Return Sam's gift
scenes.voiceover: Sam already has one? Return Sam's gift. PayPal refunds it, and his thirty dollars go right back into his envelope.
scenes.caption: Refund → back into Sam's envelope
actions: click the chip 'Return Sam's gift'
Refund issued card with the PayPal refund ID; Sam's envelope has $30.00 again
point at the topbar meter

scenes.title: Ledger in AG Grid
scenes.voiceover: Every step lands in AG Grid. The gift list shows each person, their envelope, the gift and its PayPal capture. Below it, the ledger: searches, decisions with their reasons, captures, refunds, and the blocked attempt in red.
scenes.caption: AG Grid: gift list + ledger
actions: click Ledger; pan the Gift list grid: Recipient, Envelope, Gift, Price, Status, PayPal capture, Left, total row
scroll to the ledger grid; type 'deny' in the filter: only the red rows; clear it
point at the Recipient and PayPal ID columns

scenes.title: Revoke
scenes.voiceover: And one click revokes it. The agent loses spending power immediately, and PayPal releases whatever is left on the hold.
scenes.caption: Revoke: spending power ends in code at once
actions: click Gift list; 'Revoke gift list', then 'Yes, revoke now'
toast 'Gift list revoked. The agent can no longer spend.'; the Revoked pill
Ledger: the paypal.void row 'PayPal authorization voided; remaining hold released'

scenes.title: Architecture
scenes.voiceover: Under the hood: one Node and React service on Render. Gemini through the Vercel AI SDK, with a Groq fallback. The model only calls tools. A policy engine checks every envelope, and PayPal is the outer bound.
scenes.srtNote: Gemini · Vercel AI SDK · Groq · Channel3 · PayPal Orders v2 + Payments v2 · AG Grid · Render
actions: architecture card, revealed in three steps that follow the narration

scenes.title: Back to the gift list
actions: back to the Gift list page with the revoked list, a slow scroll over the envelopes

scenes.title: End card
scenes.voiceover: [warm] Ribbon. Every gift on your list, tied to one PayPal approval.
actions: end card: tagline, github.com/Tomiyato/allowance, allowance-cpp0.onrender.com
